# Event Countdown — Marketplace copy

**Search line:** An event countdown Stream Deck plugin for holidays, birthdays and custom dates, with a draining hourglass background and amber-to-red urgency as the day nears.

**Tagline:** Every day that matters, on your deck.

**What it is:** Event Countdown puts a live countdown on any key. Pick a holiday, a birthday, or type your own date and time. Each key is independent, so you can fill a wall with them.

**Features:**
- Built-in presets: Christmas, New Year, Valentine's, Halloween, July 4th, Thanksgiving, Mother's and Father's Day, plus Birthday and Custom.
- Days-only by default, switching to hours within a day and minutes within an hour.
- A background that drains as the event approaches, so progress is always visible.
- Turns amber under 24 hours, pulses red under 1 hour, then celebrates when the day arrives.
- Pure date math. No internet, no setup.
